parameters.name: length_a
parameters.description: Unit-cell length a.

parameters.name: length_b
parameters.description: Unit-cell length b.

parameters.name: length_c
parameters.description: Unit-cell length c.

parameters.name: angle_alpha
parameters.description: Unit-cell angle between b and c (degrees; engine converts to radians).

parameters.name: angle_beta
parameters.description: Unit-cell angle between a and c (degrees; engine converts to radians).

parameters.name: angle_gamma
parameters.description: Unit-cell angle between a and b (degrees; engine converts to radians).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique atom-site identifier.

parameters.name: type_symbol
parameters.description: Chemical symbol of the atom at this site.

parameters.name: wyckoff_letter
parameters.description: Wyckoff letter of the site in its space group.

parameters.name: adp_type
parameters.description: Atomic displacement parameter type: Biso, Uiso, Bani, Uani or beta; Biso when absent.

parameters.name: fract_x
parameters.description: Fractional x-coordinate of the atom site.

parameters.name: fract_y
parameters.description: Fractional y-coordinate of the atom site.

parameters.name: fract_z
parameters.description: Fractional z-coordinate of the atom site.

parameters.name: occupancy
parameters.description: Site occupancy (raw occupancy; m/M multiplicity applied in |F|^2).

parameters.name: adp_iso
parameters.description: Isotropic atomic displacement parameter in the site's declared type: B for Biso, U for Uiso (B = 8 pi^2 U); an anisotropic site's equivalent isotropic value, derived.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the anisotropic atom site the row belongs to.

parameters.name: adp_11
parameters.units: Å² for Uani/Bani; dimensionless for beta
parameters.description: Anisotropic displacement tensor component 11 (diagonal 11) in the site's declared type: U for Uani, B for Bani (Å²), dimensionless beta for beta.

parameters.name: adp_22
parameters.units: Å² for Uani/Bani; dimensionless for beta
parameters.description: Anisotropic displacement tensor component 22 (diagonal 22) in the site's declared type: U for Uani, B for Bani (Å²), dimensionless beta for beta.

parameters.name: adp_33
parameters.units: Å² for Uani/Bani; dimensionless for beta
parameters.description: Anisotropic displacement tensor component 33 (diagonal 33) in the site's declared type: U for Uani, B for Bani (Å²), dimensionless beta for beta.

parameters.name: adp_12
parameters.units: Å² for Uani/Bani; dimensionless for beta
parameters.description: Anisotropic displacement tensor component 12 (off-diagonal 12) in the site's declared type: U for Uani, B for Bani (Å²), dimensionless beta for beta.

parameters.name: adp_13
parameters.units: Å² for Uani/Bani; dimensionless for beta
parameters.description: Anisotropic displacement tensor component 13 (off-diagonal 13) in the site's declared type: U for Uani, B for Bani (Å²), dimensionless beta for beta.

parameters.name: adp_23
parameters.units: Å² for Uani/Bani; dimensionless for beta
parameters.description: Anisotropic displacement tensor component 23 (off-diagonal 23) in the site's declared type: U for Uani, B for Bani (Å²), dimensionless beta for beta.

parameters.name: rise_alpha_0
parameters.description: Back-to-back exponential rise-rate coefficient alpha_0 (rate, 1/us; no closed unit code).

parameters.name: rise_alpha_1
parameters.description: Back-to-back exponential rise-rate coefficient alpha_1 (alpha(d)=alpha_0+alpha_1/d).

parameters.name: decay_beta_0
parameters.description: Back-to-back exponential decay-rate coefficient beta_0 (rate, 1/us; no closed unit code).

parameters.name: decay_beta_1
parameters.description: Back-to-back exponential decay-rate coefficient beta_1 (beta(d)=beta_0+beta_1/d^4).

parameters.name: broad_gauss_sigma_0
parameters.description: Gaussian VARIANCE coefficient sigma_0^2 (variance domain; TCH consumes FWHM_G=sqrt(sigma^2)*sqrt(8 ln 2)).

parameters.name: broad_gauss_sigma_1
parameters.description: Gaussian VARIANCE coefficient sigma_1^2 (d^2 term; variance domain).

parameters.name: broad_gauss_sigma_2
parameters.description: Gaussian VARIANCE coefficient sigma_2^2 (d^4 term; us^2/A^4 not in closed vocab -> none).

parameters.name: broad_gauss_size
parameters.description: Gaussian isotropic size broadening (variance contribution).

parameters.name: broad_gauss_strain
parameters.description: Gaussian isotropic strain broadening (variance contribution).

parameters.name: broad_lorentz_gamma_0
parameters.description: Lorentzian FWHM coefficient gamma_0 (FWHM domain, H_L; consumed as FWHM directly, no sqrt(8 ln 2)).

parameters.name: broad_lorentz_gamma_1
parameters.description: Lorentzian FWHM coefficient gamma_1 (d term; FWHM domain).

parameters.name: broad_lorentz_gamma_2
parameters.description: Lorentzian FWHM coefficient gamma_2 (d^2 term; FWHM domain).

parameters.name: broad_lorentz_size
parameters.description: Lorentzian isotropic size broadening (FWHM).

parameters.name: broad_lorentz_strain
parameters.description: Lorentzian isotropic strain broadening (FWHM).

parameters.name: broad_gauss_u
parameters.description: Caglioti Gaussian FWHM coefficient U (tan^2(theta) term; H_G^2 in deg^2).

parameters.name: broad_gauss_v
parameters.description: Caglioti Gaussian FWHM coefficient V (tan(theta) term; H_G^2 in deg^2).

parameters.name: broad_gauss_w
parameters.description: Caglioti Gaussian FWHM coefficient W (constant term; H_G^2 in deg^2).

parameters.name: broad_lorentz_x
parameters.description: Lorentzian FWHM coefficient X, strain-like (tan(theta) term; H_L in deg).

parameters.name: broad_lorentz_y
parameters.description: Lorentzian FWHM coefficient Y, size-like (1/cos(theta) term; H_L in deg).

parameters.name: mixing_eta_0
parameters.description: Pseudo-Voigt mixing at 2theta = 0: eta = eta_0 + eta_1 2theta (FullProf Eta0).

parameters.name: mixing_eta_1
parameters.description: Pseudo-Voigt mixing slope per degree 2theta: eta = eta_0 + eta_1 2theta (FullProf X of Npr 5).

parameters.name: asym_fcj_1
parameters.description: Finger-Cox-Jephcoat asymmetry parameter 1: S/L, half the sample height over the diffractometer radius.

parameters.name: asym_fcj_2
parameters.description: Finger-Cox-Jephcoat asymmetry parameter 2: D/L, half the detector height over the diffractometer radius.

parameters.name: asym_beba_a0
parameters.description: Berar-Baldinozzi asymmetry coefficient A0 (Fa/tan theta).

parameters.name: asym_beba_b0
parameters.description: Berar-Baldinozzi asymmetry coefficient B0 (Fb/tan theta).

parameters.name: asym_beba_a1
parameters.description: Berar-Baldinozzi asymmetry coefficient A1 (Fa/tan 2theta).

parameters.name: asym_beba_b1
parameters.description: Berar-Baldinozzi asymmetry coefficient B1 (Fb/tan 2theta).

parameters.name: asym_beba_limit
parameters.description: Berar-Baldinozzi limit angle (deg 2theta): reflections at or above it get no asymmetry correction (FullProf AsyLim); default 180.

parameters.name: calib_d_to_tof_offset
parameters.description: TOF calibration zero offset in the active quadratic calibration; the reciprocal field is retained but not applied.

parameters.name: calib_d_to_tof_linear
parameters.description: TOF calibration linear coefficient Dtt1 (us/A).

parameters.name: calib_d_to_tof_quadratic
parameters.description: TOF calibration quadratic coefficient Dtt2 (us/A^2).

parameters.name: calib_d_to_tof_reciprocal
parameters.description: TOF calibration reciprocal (1/d) coefficient (us*A); round-tripped, held fixed in the free set.

parameters.name: calib_twotheta_offset
parameters.description: CW zero-point offset in degrees 2theta, subtracted from the observed axis.

parameters.name: setup_wavelength
parameters.description: Primary incident CW wavelength in Å; a second wavelength is specific to the X-ray doublet model.

parameters.name: calib_sample_displacement
parameters.description: CW sample-displacement line shift in degrees 2theta (FullProf SyCos): adds displacement*cos(2theta_B) to each reflection's position.

parameters.name: calib_sample_transparency
parameters.description: CW sample-transparency line shift in degrees 2theta (FullProf SySin): adds transparency*sin(2theta_B) to each reflection's position.

parameters.name: setup_polarization_coefficient
parameters.description: X-ray CW polarization coefficient K (FullProf Rpolarz): the intensity carries P = 1 - K + K cos^2(2theta_m) cos^2(2theta); 0 disables the correction.

parameters.name: setup_monochromator_twotheta
parameters.description: X-ray CW pre-specimen monochromator angle 2theta_m in degrees (FullProf stores Cthm = cos^2(2theta_m)); 0 means no monochromator.

parameters.name: setup_wavelength_2
parameters.description: X-ray CW second incident wavelength in angstroms (FullProf Lambda2, e.g. Cu K-alpha2); used when setup_wavelength_2_to_1_ratio is not 0.

parameters.name: setup_wavelength_2_to_1_ratio
parameters.description: X-ray CW intensity of the second wavelength relative to the first (FullProf Ratio); 0 means a single wavelength.

parameters.name: abscor1
parameters.description: TOF sample absorption coefficient ABSCOR1 (muR = ABSCOR1 * lambda; refinable).

parameters.name: abscor2
parameters.description: TOF sample absorption lambda-power ABSCOR2 (round-tripped, held fixed; freeing it is a hard error).

parameters.name: mu_r
parameters.description: CW cylinder sample absorption mu*R.

parameters.name: domain_radius
parameters.description: Becker-Coppens domain (mosaic block) radius r (micrometres; extinction types II and mixed; single crystal; a fit parameter).

parameters.name: mosaic_spread
parameters.description: Becker-Coppens mosaic spread g of the crystal, the inverse width of its mosaic distribution (larger is narrower; radians to the minus one; extinction types I and mixed; single crystal; a fit parameter).

parameters.name: crystal_radius
parameters.description: Radius of the crystal taken as a sphere, which sets each reflection's mean path length through it for the Becker-Coppens secondary extinction (millimetres, as _exptl_crystal.size_rad; every Becker-Coppens type; single crystal; a descriptor, never fitted).

parameters.name: coefficient
parameters.description: Larson's empirical extinction coefficient x, as SHELXL's EXTI: F2calc is multiplied by [1 + 0.001 x F2calc lambda^3 / sin 2theta]^(-1/2) (extinction type larson-isotropic; single crystal; a fit parameter).

parameters.name: coefficient_11
parameters.description: The term of h² in Larson's anisotropic extinction tensor x_aniso = x11 h^2 + x22 k^2 + x33 l^2 + x12 hk + x13 hl + x23 kl, which takes the place of 4 x (sin theta/lambda)^2 (FullProf's Ext1; extinction type larson-anisotropic; single crystal; a fit parameter).

parameters.name: coefficient_22
parameters.description: The term of k² in Larson's anisotropic extinction tensor x_aniso = x11 h^2 + x22 k^2 + x33 l^2 + x12 hk + x13 hl + x23 kl, which takes the place of 4 x (sin theta/lambda)^2 (FullProf's Ext2; extinction type larson-anisotropic; single crystal; a fit parameter).

parameters.name: coefficient_33
parameters.description: The term of l² in Larson's anisotropic extinction tensor x_aniso = x11 h^2 + x22 k^2 + x33 l^2 + x12 hk + x13 hl + x23 kl, which takes the place of 4 x (sin theta/lambda)^2 (FullProf's Ext3; extinction type larson-anisotropic; single crystal; a fit parameter).

parameters.name: coefficient_12
parameters.description: The term of hk in Larson's anisotropic extinction tensor x_aniso = x11 h^2 + x22 k^2 + x33 l^2 + x12 hk + x13 hl + x23 kl, which takes the place of 4 x (sin theta/lambda)^2 (FullProf's Ext4; extinction type larson-anisotropic; single crystal; a fit parameter).

parameters.name: coefficient_13
parameters.description: The term of hl in Larson's anisotropic extinction tensor x_aniso = x11 h^2 + x22 k^2 + x33 l^2 + x12 hk + x13 hl + x23 kl, which takes the place of 4 x (sin theta/lambda)^2 (FullProf's Ext5; extinction type larson-anisotropic; single crystal; a fit parameter).

parameters.name: coefficient_23
parameters.description: The term of kl in Larson's anisotropic extinction tensor x_aniso = x11 h^2 + x22 k^2 + x33 l^2 + x12 hk + x13 hl + x23 kl, which takes the place of 4 x (sin theta/lambda)^2 (FullProf's Ext6; extinction type larson-anisotropic; single crystal; a fit parameter).

parameters.name: march_r
parameters.description: March-Dollase coefficient r.

parameters.name: march_random_fract
parameters.description: Random (untextured) fraction mixed with the March-Dollase term.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Scale factor of one linked structure's (phase's) pattern, the overall pattern scale when there is one structure (dimensionless; linear).

parameters.name: intensity
parameters.description: Line-segment background intensity anchor (dimensionless in the reduced pattern; linear).

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Background anchor position (TOF, us); a fixed node, not a refinable Parameter.

parameters.name: coef
parameters.description: Polynomial or Chebyshev background coefficient of the row's order (dimensionless in the reduced pattern; linear).

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Order m of a polynomial or Chebyshev background term (a non-negative integer; a fixed node, not a refinable Parameter).

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Origin of the polynomial background, FullProf Bkpos: the terms are powers of x/origin - 1 (in the pattern's axis units; non-zero).

parameters.name: x_min
parameters.description: Lower end of the Chebyshev background's normalisation domain (in the pattern's axis units).

parameters.name: x_max
parameters.description: Upper end of the Chebyshev background's normalisation domain (in the pattern's axis units; above x_min).

assistant_rules: Identify sample form, beam mode, radiation and selected model before selecting an equation.
Cite the exact explanatory section and equation anchor.
Do not infer a GUI editor or a Command Line option from engine model support.
Do not describe stored-only items as active or refinable.
Use Features for surface-specific availability; planned work is not available functionality.
If the installed build differs or a topic is absent, say the reference does not establish support and inspect the build instead of inventing behaviour.
Refinable metadata alone does not prove that a quantity can be freed: check its role, selected model and derived/symmetry restrictions.
